requirements.observation: CI projects the current stage. It selects an approval for leaving that stage after the latest entry. Projected-stage, stageless-record and earlier-visit controls pass.
Grounding and Planning pilot captures pass with empty head/diff approval fields. Binding-stage stale head/diff inputs refuse.
Host appends serialize. Pending intent recovery retains verified prefixes. Process-exit, power-image, fsync-failure and concurrent-writer checks pass.
All five supported terminal outcomes refuse host writes in the serial suite. Actual core ABORTED API calls serialize against all four host commands in both commit orders.
CI refuses stores inside the tested repository, including symlink path controls.
Resolve uses the shared strict decoder. A second document and trailing garbage refuse. Whitespace remains accepted.
HIGH/CRITICAL cannot select weaker policy separation. Applicable capabilities are conjoined. Final/disputed host review dispatches require both family separations. Normal-work controls pass.
The second coding gate revalidates current route approval, review approval, core head and exact live artifact.

Only a regular marker naming the canonical scratch path and run passes. The sole prior seed record must equal seedCore output. Validly hashed PASSED, actor, timestamp, unit and control alterations refuse.
Every dogfood refusal compares a SHA-256 fingerprint of store file names and bytes. Core and host record/head files are covered. Empty lock files are excluded.
Direct structural route-attestation tests exercise all required fields and execution-context vocabulary. Record-boundary validation controls pass.
The CI workflow invokes the hardened dogfood harness. A local real-CLI run passes all 17 checks.
Full CLI controls review A before mutation. An otherwise valid current B approval cannot reuse the A review. Current clean/dirty artifacts advance.
Empty/foreign roots, stale head/diff, unapproved dirt and checkout mutation refuse. Real clean and explicitly bound dirty pilot captures pass. CI supports clean revision capture.
Full dirty-artifact transitions reject stale reviews with the optional approval worktree field absent or populated. Unchanged controls pass.

deferred_scope.authority: Neutral closure criteria. Statuses, verdicts, diagnoses of current code, and implementer claims removed. F01-F05 come from the first blind closure review. C01-C04 come from the second blind closure review. R3-01..R3-04 come from the third blind closure review. Lennon deferred plan-derived dependent invalidation (F05, C04, R3-03) to Gate D on 2026-10-16; the conservative all-units invalidation must remain in force.
deferred_scope.current_safety: Any approved unit rewind to Grounding, Acceptance criteria or Planning invalidates all unit routes. Fresh approved route records can establish new authority.
deferred_scope.diagnosis: Persisted replay lacks a verified dependency graph and cannot preserve an unaffected unit selectively.
deferred_scope.preferred_fix: In Gate D, bind a validated plan graph to approval/replay. Compute transitive dependents from that graph. Preserve conservative invalidation whenever graph validation fails.

verification.method: Use U2 -> U1 -> U0 and independent U3, then rewind U0. Repeat missing/corrupt graph, whole-run rewind and review re-attestation.
verification.expected: Old U1/U2 routes refuse. U3 survives only with a verified graph. Missing/corrupt graphs refuse conservatively. Fresh properly bound human authorization establishes new authority.

deferred_scope.tradeoffs: Adds persisted plan/provenance and migration work. Narrowing before graph validation would weaken the current safe fallback.
deferred_scope.alternative: Retain all-unit invalidation indefinitely; safe but unnecessarily revokes independent units.
deferred_scope.status: proposed; deferred, not implemented or validated

limitations: The repository was not mounted read-only. Read-only behavior was procedural and verified by start/end hashes and a 145-file byte/mode/symlink comparison against the start copy. All tests, helper builds, stores and probe changes were under this output directory.

Isolation is conversational blinding in a fresh session. It is not a fresh machine or a hardware isolation claim. Repository code/test comments remained visible as audited artifacts. No prior verdict/report was needed or read; retained test sources and TODO Gate B claims were read only after PHASE1.json was frozen.
The storage evidence uses process death, syscall fault injection and a directory-entry loss model. It does not prove behavior on all hardware/filesystems or physically cut device power.
Linux case-sensitive filesystem only. Case-insensitive host behavior was not exercised. Windows and other unsupported platform locking paths were not exercised.
Go 1.27.1 linux/amd64 and Git 2.43.0 were used. The earlier audit cited Go 1.24.0; that toolchain was not separately reproduced.

Named historical checks were rerun where retained fixtures were available and relevant. The report does not claim every old test name was replayed verbatim. Current equivalent matrices and source analysis supply the listed coverage. Dynamic syscall counts differ from historical 40/55 counts because the current protocol and environment differ.

Repository helpers supply fixture creation and JSON serialization in some independent probes. Assertions and new negative matrices were auditor-written. The explicit retained-fixture adaptations and provenance are available.
The synthetic dogfood run does not dispatch a real worker, perform an actual route hi handshake, or provide genuine human approval. It validates CLI enforcement, not full host MVP conformance.

F05, C04 and R3-03 remain PARTIAL. The authoritative criteria note defers plan-derived invalidation to Gate D. A fresh route may be recorded without resolving a plan artifact; conservative all-unit rewind invalidation remains the Gate B boundary.
Full approved provider/model/permission fact binding, Gate C integration, Gate D leases/graph semantics, successful release outcomes and release/publication authority are outside this Gate B audit.

Same-UID coherent store rewriting is out of scope under the trusted-host threat model. No external APIs, nested agent CLIs, model calls, audited-repository Git writes or audited-file edits were used. Git fixture creation occurred only in scratch test directories. Jev was unavailable; the auditor used the recorded fallback.
